moments.title: The one participant who picked debt: she wanted stability in her portfolio
moments.summary: Going through the game results, the facilitator singles out the only player who chose debt — named in the audio as Shruti — and she says she would prefer more stability.
moments.evidence: So at this point if she had to marry, she would look for stability in her portfolio.

moments.title: Why most of the room chose equity: potential for growth, and excitement
moments.summary: Asked why they picked equity, the players answer potential for growth, liquidity and excitement, and the facilitator repeats each answer back.
moments.evidence: Why did most of you choose equity? Potential for growth.
